Name: ChestEnhancement
Author: sskerye
Description:
[center][size=6][b]箱子增强[/b][/size]
更多储物空间，更轻松的收纳与农场生产[/center]

从整理背包到管理农场生产，箱子增强让储物箱承担更多日常工作。扩大储物空间、快速归置物品、直接使用箱中材料制作，还能连接加工机器、蟹笼和多种生产设施，自动投料、补饵并收回产物。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]更大的储物空间[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]普通木箱扩展至 [b]72 格[/b]，木质大箱扩展至 [b]140 格[/b]。[/*]
[*]农舍、姜岛农舍的主冰箱及迷你冰箱扩展至 [b]108 格[/b]。[/*]
[*]祝尼魔箱扩展至 [b]75 格[/b]，继续使用共享库存。[/*]
[*]石箱容量保持原版。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]一键整理背包[/color][/b][/size]
在背包界面点击快捷存放按钮，即可将物品补入附近箱子[b]已有的同类堆叠[/b]。提前分好类，采集或下矿回来后，就能快速归置背包中的材料。

存放范围默认 [b]5×5 格[/b]，可在设置中调整为 [b]3×3 至 10×10 格[/b]。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]材料留在箱里，也能直接制作[/color][/b][/size]
打开背包制作页，即可使用[b]当前地点[/b]普通箱子、大箱子和祝尼魔箱中的材料，减少来回翻箱取料。厨房烹饪、冰箱和工作台仍沿用各自的取料方式。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]连接机器，自动投料与收货[/color][/b][/size]
把普通箱子或大箱子与加工机器连接起来，机器就能从箱中取料，并将完成的产品收回箱中。普通加工机器通过[b]上下左右相邻[/b]连接，可以连续排列，不必每台都紧挨箱子。

将矿石和煤放入箱子，让熔炉炼锭；存入水果，让酒桶酿酒。自动化仍消耗正常材料，并保留原有加工时间。

[b]同一生产网络可以连接多个箱子。[/b]收货时，优先选择已有可堆叠同类物品且空间足够的箱子；没有合适的同类库存时，再选择距离较近、能够容纳产物的箱子。单纯把箱子排成一串不会延长生产网络。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]蟹笼与分散设施也能加入[/color][/b][/size]
[b]蟹笼支持自动收取捕获物，并从相连箱子中补充鱼饵。[/b]

以下设施支持间隔连接，让沿岸、树林和其他分散摆放的设施更容易接入生产网络，无需每台都紧贴箱子：
[list]
[*]蟹笼[/*]
[*]树液采集器，包括重型树液采集器[/*]
[*]蜂房[/*]
[*]避雷针[/*]
[*]蘑菇树桩[/*]
[*]太阳能板[/*]
[/list]相连[b]鱼塘[/b]的产物也可以自动收取。

[b]自动化使用说明[/b]
[list]
[*]使用普通箱子和大箱子作为生产储物箱，不使用冰箱或祝尼魔箱。[/*]
[*]自动收取与投料目前处理玩家所在地点；联机时由主机执行，处理主机所在地点。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]装着物品，也能搬动[/color][/b][/size]
普通箱子、大箱子、迷你冰箱和祝尼魔箱可以[b]带着内容收起并重新放置[/b]，调整布局时无需先清空。搬动祝尼魔箱只移动箱体，共享库存保持不变。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]给箱子命名[/color][/b][/size]
为箱子取名“矿石”“种子”或“待加工材料”，鼠标指向箱子即可查看。默认按 [b]N[/b] 修改名称，也可以自行更换按键。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]更新中的稳定性改进[/color][/b][/size]
修复部分情况下箱子被误判为占用、无法正常打开，以及相关操作长时间停滞的问题，改善就地取材、快捷存放和自动生产之间的衔接。

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]安装与设置[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]先安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]解压模组，将 [b]SSkeryeChestEnhancement[/b] 文件夹放入游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 目录。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]各项功能均可独立开关。安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 后，可以在游戏内调整功能、存放范围和命名按键；也可编辑 [b]config.json[/b]。设置保存后需要[b]重启游戏[/b]生效。

[b][color=#D9B36A]关闭扩容或卸载前[/color][/b]
请先取出超出原版容量格位中的物品，避免恢复原版界面后无法访问。


[center][size=6][b]Chest Enhancement[/b][/size]
More storage space, easier organization, and smoother farm production[/center]

From sorting your inventory to managing farm production, Chest Enhancement helps your chests do more of the everyday work. Expand your storage, put items away quickly, craft directly from stored materials, and connect machines, Crab Pots, and other production equipment to automatically supply ingredients, refill bait, and collect finished products.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]More Storage Space[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Wooden Chests expand to [b]72 slots[/b], and wooden Big Chests expand to [b]140 slots[/b].[/*]
[*]The main fridges in the Farmhouse and Island Farmhouse, along with Mini-Fridges, expand to [b]108 slots[/b].[/*]
[*]Junimo Chests expand to [b]75 slots[/b] while retaining their shared inventory.[/*]
[*]Stone Chest capacity stays unchanged.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Put Items Away in One Click[/color][/b][/size]
Click the quick deposit button in your inventory to add items to [b]existing matching stacks[/b] in nearby chests. Organize your chests beforehand, then quickly put away your materials after a trip to the mines or a day of gathering.

The default deposit area is [b]5×5 tiles[/b]. You can adjust it from [b]3×3 to 10×10 tiles[/b] in the settings.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Craft with Materials Still in Your Chests[/color][/b][/size]
Open the crafting tab in your inventory to use materials from regular Chests, Big Chests, and Junimo Chests in [b]your current location[/b]. Spend less time searching through storage and moving ingredients into your backpack. Kitchen cooking, fridges, and Workbenches keep their existing ingredient access rules.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Connect Machines for Automatic Loading and Collection[/color][/b][/size]
Connect a regular Chest or Big Chest to processing machines, and they can take ingredients from the chest and return finished products to storage. Standard processing machines connect through [b]adjacent tiles above, below, left, or right[/b], so you can arrange them in connected rows without placing every machine directly beside a chest.

Put ore and coal in a chest to supply your Furnaces, or add fruit to supply your Kegs. Automation still consumes the normal ingredients and keeps the original processing times.

[b]A single production network can connect to multiple chests.[/b] Finished products go to a chest that already contains matching stackable items and has enough room whenever possible. If no suitable matching chest is available, a closer chest with enough space is chosen instead. Simply placing chests in a row does not extend the production network.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Crab Pots and Spaced-Out Equipment[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Crab Pots can have their catches collected automatically and their bait replenished from connected chests.[/b]

The following equipment can connect across gaps, making it easier to include equipment spread along shorelines, among trees, or around your farm without placing every piece directly beside a chest:
[list]
[*]Crab Pots[/*]
[*]Tappers, including Heavy Tappers[/*]
[*]Bee Houses[/*]
[*]Lightning Rods[/*]
[*]Mushroom Logs[/*]
[*]Solar Panels[/*]
[/list]Products from connected [b]Fish Ponds[/b] can also be collected automatically.

[b]Using Automation[/b]
[list]
[*]Use regular Chests and Big Chests for production storage. Fridges and Junimo Chests are not used by automation.[/*]
[*]Automatic collection and loading currently operate in the player's current location. In multiplayer, automation runs on the host and processes the host's current location.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Move Chests with Their Contents[/color][/b][/size]
Regular Chests, Big Chests, Mini-Fridges, and Junimo Chests can be [b]picked up and placed again with their contents intact[/b], so you can rearrange your storage without emptying everything first. Moving a Junimo Chest only moves the chest itself; its shared inventory remains unchanged.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Name Your Chests[/color][/b][/size]
Give your chests names such as "Ore", "Seeds", or "Ready to Process", then hover over a chest to see its name. Press [b]N[/b] by default to rename it, or choose a different key in the settings.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Stability Improvements[/color][/b][/size]
Fixes cases where chests could be incorrectly treated as busy, fail to open normally, or leave related actions stalled for an extended period. These changes improve how crafting from storage, quick deposit, and machine automation work together.

[size=4][b][color=#D9B36A]Installation and Settings[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI first.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod archive and place the [b]SSkeryeChestEnhancement[/b] folder in your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Each feature can be enabled or disabled independently. With [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, you can adjust features, the deposit area, and the rename key in-game. You can also edit [b]config.json[/b] directly. Save your settings and [b]restart the game[/b] for changes to take effect.

[b][color=#D9B36A]Before Disabling Expanded Storage or Uninstalling[/color][/b]
Remove any items stored in slots beyond the original capacity first, as those slots will no longer be accessible through the original interface.
